deploy.startCommand: [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; if [ -d /data ]; then DBDIR=/data; mkdir -p /data/uploads; cp -rn /app/public/uploads/. /data/uploads/ 2>/dev/null || true; [ -L /app/public/uploads ] || { rm -rf /app/public/uploads; ln -sfn /data/uploads /app/public/uploads; }; elif [ -d /app/database ] && [ ! -d /app/database/migrations ]; then DBDIR=/app/database; tar -xzf /app/build/db-skeleton.tar.gz; else DBDIR=; fi; if [ -n "$DBDIR" ]; then mkdir -p "$DBDIR"; [ -f "$DBDIR/database.sqlite" ] || { [ "$DBDIR" != "/app/database" ] && [ -f /app/database/database.sqlite ] && cp /app/database/database.sqlite "$DBDIR/"; [ -f "$DBDIR/database.sqlite" ] || touch "$DBDIR/database.sqlite"; }; export DB_DATABASE="$DBDIR/database.sqlite"; fi; php artisan key:generate --force; php artisan migrate --force; php artisan db:seed --force; php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
